pretreatments.description: Alkaline pretreatment using sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solutions at concentrations of 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8% w/v in 500 mL Pyrex glass bottles with 350 mL working volume. Samples were stirred at 250 rpm, subjected to 37 °C for 3 hours in a water bath, and neutralized to pH 7 with 0.02 N H2SO4.

Photocatalytic pretreatment using titanium dioxide (TiO2) nanoparticles with doses of 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, and 0.6 g/L in a 1L beaker with 600 mL working volume, placed in an enclosed chamber with 4 UV-B lamps (100 W, 320 nm), stirred for 3 hours at 37 °C, and neutralized to pH 7.

Alkaline-photocatalytic pretreatment combining the conditions from alkaline pretreatment and photocatalytic pretreatment. Each dose of NaOH used in alkaline pretreatment was combined with all TiO2 NPs doses used in photocatalytic pretreatment. Pretreatment conditions remained the same, including stirring and temperature (37 °C for 3 hours), with samples neutralized to pH 7.
